title: NTC fines 80 buses for overcharging during New Year period
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) has taken action to fine 80 buses for overcharging passengers during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year period.

title: Two bodies recovered after drowning incident in Nallachchiya Reservoir
byline: Two bodies have been recovered inside a culvert along a canal carrying water from the left bank of the Nallachchiya Reservoir in Thambuttegama, police said.

title: Indian VP to arrive in Sri Lanka today; Special traffic plan announced
byline: The Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan is scheduled to arrive in Sri Lanka today (19) on an official visit.

title: Fairly heavy rainfall expected in several parts of the island
byline: Atmospheric conditions will be favorable for afternoon thundershowers in most parts of the island from tomorrow (20), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Trump hails Israel as ‘great ally,’ hits out at nations that ‘have shown their true colors’
byline: President Donald Trump has strongly defended Israel in a recent post on Truth Social, calling the country a ‘‘great ally’’ and praising its strength and resilience during times of conflict.

title: Iran declares the Strait of Hormuz fully closed, state media reports
byline: The navy of Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps said it extended the closure to the corridor it had earlier designated for the safe passage of vessels through the strategic waterway and declared the strait fully closed until the U.S. blockade on Iranian ports and ships is lifted.

title: Trump, Iran cite progress in talks as uncertainty hangs over Strait
byline: Iran’s top negotiator said recent talks with the U.S. had made progress but gaps remained over nuclear issues and the Strait of Hormuz, while President Donald Trump cited ‘‘very good conversations’‘ with Tehran despite warning against ‘‘blackmail’‘ over the key shipping channel.

title: Shooting incident reported in residence at Midigama
byline: A shooting incident has been reported in the Midigama area last night (18) at around 11.40 p.m.

title: Indian Vice President arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: The Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan has arrived in Sri Lanka, a short while ago.

title: At least six killed in Kyiv as gunman opens fire and takes hostages
byline: At least six people have been killed and others injured after a person opened fire in Kyiv on Saturday, Ukrainian officials say.

title: Trump ‘pulled’ into war by Netanyahu, says former VP
byline: Former Vice-President Kamala Harris says Donald Trump has been ‘‘pulled’’ into war with Iran by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

title: Bangladeshi national arrested with foreign cigarettes worth Rs. 5.1 mln at BIA
byline: A foreign national who attempted to smuggle a stock of foreign cigarettes has been arrested by a group of Customs officers at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA).

title: Indian Vice President meets President Dissanayake
byline: The Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan, called on President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at the Presidential Secretariat in Colombo today (19), engaging in high-level discussions aimed at further strengthening the longstanding relationship between India and Sri Lanka.

title: Mother and daughter killed in suspected arson attack in Maharagama
byline: A mother and her teenage daughter have been killed in a suspected arson attack at a two-storey residence in Maharagama, police said.

title: Two officials of Mullaitivu Hospital arrested over bribery allegation
byline: An accountant and a management assistant at the Mullaitivu District Hospital have been arrested by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over allegations of accepting a bribe of Rs. 30,000.

title: Passengers urged to report buses overcharging, not issuing tickets – NTC
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) has urged passengers to lodge complaints against buses that overcharge fares or fail to issue tickets.

title: Opposition responds to resignation of Energy Minister over coal procurement
byline: The Joint Opposition has issued a statement regarding the resignation of Minister of Energy Kumara Jayakody and the Secretary to the Ministry, Prof. Udayanga Hemapala, who stepped down amid ongoing investigations into a coal procurement process.

title: Live hand grenade found in Eppawala reservoir, STF called for controlled detonation
byline: A live hand grenade has been discovered in the Nabadawewa reservoir in Andagala, Eppawala.

title: Pakistan tightens security ahead of expected US-Iran talks
byline: Pakistan has placed its capital Islamabad and the neighboring garrison city of Rawalpindi on high security alert ahead of the expected second round of U.S.-Iran talks.

title: Man arrested over alleged drugging and theft on Anuradhapura–Colombo bus
byline: Police have arrested an individual in connection with a theft involving cash and gold jewellery after allegedly offering food and beverages laced with intoxicating substances to three women travelling on a bus, the Police Media Division said.

title: Malaysia joins growing number of Southeast Asian countries seeking to secure Russian oil
byline: Malaysia is joining a growing list of countries in Southeast Asia seeking to secure oil from Russia amid an energy crunch as a result of the US-Israel conflict with Iran that is now into its eighth week.

title: Indian VP and PM Harini hold discussions to further strengthen bilateral ties
byline: The Visiting Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan has held discussions with Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya at the Temple Trees in Colombo today (19).

title: Visiting Indian Vice President meets Opposition Leader
byline: Visiting Vice President of India C. P. Radhakrishnan has held discussions with the Leader of the Opposition, Sajith Premadasa in Colombo today (19).

title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles again, flexing muscle amid Iran war
byline: North Korea fired ballistic missiles into the sea on Sunday, accelerating its missile launches amid Iran war tensions and talk of possible meetings with the U.S. and South Korea.

title: Opposition calls for Audit report on coal procurement to be referred to Attorney General
byline: The Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) has called for the immediate submission of the audit report detailing alleged irregularities in coal procurement to the Attorney General through Parliament.

title: Titanic life jacket sells for £670,000 at auction
byline: A life jacket worn by a Titanic survivor has been sold at auction to a collector for £670,000.

title: Russian woman killed in train collision at Kabalana railway crossing
byline: A 23-year-old Russian woman has died after being struck by an express train traveling from Beliatta to Colombo.

title: President calls on Chief Prelate of Amarapura Chapter
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake visited the headquarters of the Amarapura Maha Nikaya in Wellawatte this morning (19) and met the Supreme Mahanayake Thero of Sri Lanka Amarapura Maha Nikaya, Most Venerable Karagoda Uyangoda Maithree Murthi Mahanayake Thera and received his blessings.

title: Donald Trump says US representatives heading to Pakistan for Iran talks
byline: President Donald Trump said Sunday that US representatives are traveling to Islamabad, Pakistan, for negotiations with Iran, as he accused Tehran of violating a ceasefire agreement in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Registration of Persons Dept. issues notice on resumption of services
byline: All public services offered at the Department for Registration of Persons will resume tomorrow (20), following the restoration of the system.

title: Iranian delegation to visit Pakistan on Tuesday for US talks
byline: An Iranian delegation will arrive in Pakistan on Tuesday for talks with the US, Iranian sources familiar with the negotiations say.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for most parts of the country
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Northern, North-Central, North-Western, Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern and Eastern provinces and the Monaragala district.

title: Visiting Indian Vice President meets Tamil Leaders in Colombo
byline: Visiting Vice President of India CP Radhakrishnan on Sunday met leaders of political parties in the North and East and Indian Origin Tamil parties during his visit to Sri Lanka, reinforcing India’s commitment to the welfare of the Tamil community in the island.

title: Air Force personnel deployed for expressway rescue operations
byline: Sri Lanka Air Force personnel have been deployed to assist in rescue operations along the expressway network, the Air Force Media Spokesperson, Group Captain Nalin Wewakumbura said.

title: Expressway revenue during festive period exceeds Rs. 441 million
byline: More than Rs. 441 million in revenue was generated from expressway usage during the New Year travel period from April 10 to April 18, the Road Development Authority (RDA) has announced.

title: Indian VP hands over 145 houses, concluding third phase of housing project in Sri Lanka
byline: The third phase of the Indian housing project implemented by the Government of India in the plantation areas has officially concluded today (19).

title: Proposed India-Sri Lanka oil pipeline link discussed during meeting between President AKD and Indian VP: Indian Foreign Secretary
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and the visiting Vice President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan held discussions on the proposed project related to the energy hub in Trincomalee and the proposal to link India and Sri Lanka through an oil pipeline, according to Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri.

title: 26 drowning incidents reported during festive period – Police
byline: A total of 26 people have lost their lives in drowning incidents during the Sinhala and Tamil New Year period, police stated.

title: Vice President JD Vance to lead US Team for Iran talks in Pakistan: White House
byline: US Vice President JD Vance will attend the next round of Iran talks in Pakistan along with special envoy Steve Witkoff and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law Jared Kushner, the White House has told CNN.

title: $50 billion worth of oil lost in 50 days of war: Report
byline: The world has lost over $50 billion worth of crude oil that has not been produced since the Iran war began nearly 50 days ago and the aftershock of the crisis will be felt for months and even years to come, according to analysts and Reuters calculations.

title: Eight children killed in Louisiana mass shooting
byline: Eight children were killed in a mass shooting in Shreveport, Louisiana, on Sunday morning, according to police.

title: Maharagama house fire likely deliberately set by owner, police say
byline: Investigations have revealed that the fire that broke out yesterday (18) in the upper floor of a two-storey house on the Pamunuwa Road, Maharagama, was intentionally set by the homeowner himself, police said.

title: Boat accident at Gregory Lake leaves vessel capsized; tourists rescued
byline: A boat carrying tourists has capsized in the Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya, due to the impact of a speeding jet ski earlier today (19).
